enchantments.tooltip: +10 Enhancement Bonus: +10 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Brilliance: This weapon glows with the light of Irian. This weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of light damage on a successful hit. In addition, critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 light damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 critical multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Radiant Blast: This weapon stores the power of the plane of Irian deep within. Occasionally, this dynamic power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with a massive blast of radiant light.
Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.

Greater Ooze Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Oozes, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +4 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 3 to 18 points of damage against the foe.

Greater Aberration Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Aberrations, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +4 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 3 to 18 points of damage against the foe.

Greater Magical Beast Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Magical Beasts, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +4 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 3 to 18 points of damage against the foe.
Acid Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Acid Resistance.
Acid Absorption +20%: Passive: 20% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
